name: Ivanti HR Service Management
summary: Ivanti HR Service Management (HRSM) runs on the Ivanti Neurons Platform. Employees submit HR requests in a portal and read HR knowledge articles there, and they see their open HR cases and their status. The product page shows no prices and offers Contact Sales.

facts.text: The portal help page from the 2023 documentation bundle lists forms for submitting a new HR case.
The same help page says the portal gives access to HR knowledge articles and FAQs, and filters content by the employee's profile.
The same help page says employees can see their open HR cases and assigned HR tasks.
The product page says HR case management captures every employee request from the self-service portal, email or chat, and says managers and employees see status at every step.

plans.name: HR Service Management
plans.notes: The product page offers See Plans and Pricing, Watch the Demo and Contact Sales. No prices appear on the page we read.

hiddenCosts: Plan details sit behind the See Plans and Pricing link. That linked page was not read for this profile.
